message.hivemind.entered: You squeeze into the hive. The bees watch you closely...
message.hivemind.no_building: The bees won't let you build in their hive.
message.hivemind.no_breaking: You damaged the hive! The guards are coming for you!
message.hivemind.queen_hit: You struck the Queen! The whole hive turns on you!
message.hivemind.raid_start: The hive is under attack! Protect the Queen!
message.hivemind.raid_won: The raiders are gone. The Queen rewards you for defending the hive.
message.hivemind.raid_lost: The Queen is badly hurt and the raiders escaped with honey...
commands.hivemind.not_in_hive: You need to be inside a hive.
commands.hivemind.raid_failed: A raid is already underway, or there is no queen here.
message.hivemind.brood.fed: The larva gobbles it up and wiggles happily.
message.hivemind.brood.patted: You give the little one a gentle pat. It snuggles down.
message.hivemind.brood.wants_food: This one's hungry. It wants honey or royal jelly.
message.hivemind.brood.wants_pat: This one's lonely. Give it a pat with an empty hand.
message.hivemind.brood.capped: The cell is sealed. It'll hatch soon!
message.hivemind.brood.sealed: The nurse bees seal the cell and leave you some Royal Jelly!
queen.hivemind.speaker: Queen: %s
queen.hivemind.greet.0: Bzz! Oh, it's you again. Welcome, welcome!
queen.hivemind.greet.1: Did you wipe your feet? The comb was just waxed.
queen.hivemind.greet.2: Have you met the little ones in the nursery yet?
queen.hivemind.greet.3: Hmm? Oh! I was just thinking about clover.
queen.hivemind.greet.4: My hive is your hive. Mostly. Don't touch the walls.
queen.hivemind.flower.0: Ooh, a flower! For me? You shouldn't have!
queen.hivemind.flower.2: I'll put this one right by the throne.
queen.hivemind.flower.3: The workers are going to be so jealous.
queen.hivemind.flower.4: Another one? You're spoiling me, sweetie.
queen.hivemind.gift.0: You've been so kind. Here, take this!
queen.hivemind.gift.1: A gift from the royal stores, just for you!
queen.hivemind.gift.2: Bzz bzz! A present for my favorite visitor!
queen.hivemind.gift.3: Don't tell the guards I gave you this, okay?
queen.hivemind.angry.1: Bzzzt! That is NOT how you treat a queen!
queen.hivemind.idle.0: La la la... honey for breakfast, honey for lunch...
queen.hivemind.idle.1: Do you think I'd look good in a little crown?
queen.hivemind.idle.2: The nursery is so busy lately. Could you help out?
queen.hivemind.idle.3: Bzz... I spy with my many eyes... something yellow!
queen.hivemind.idle.4: Have you tried honey toast? It's all the rage.
queen.hivemind.cocoon.0: Oh, you raised that one so well! Thank you!
queen.hivemind.cocoon.1: Another little one all tucked in. Bzz!
queen.hivemind.cocoon.2: You're a natural nanny, you know that?
queen.hivemind.raid_start.2: Bzzt! Not my honey, you creepy crawlies!
queen.hivemind.raid_won.0: You did it! The hive is safe! Bzz bzz!
queen.hivemind.raid_won.1: My hero! Take these, you've earned them!
queen.hivemind.raid_won.2: Phew! I knew we could count on you!
queen.hivemind.raid_lost.1: They got away... we'll be ready next time.
queen.hivemind.raid_lost.2: Bzz... I need a lie down.
